_about: The attack plan every PR runs against the red-team copy (test/redteam-attacks.test.js). Add a step when a new kind of attack matters; Aaron's own plans run from issues (.github/workflows/red-team.yml).

steps.name: A1 nobody signed in can't write

except./api/agents/register: open registration for outside agents (Aaron's standing decision): no session, a key is issued; an empty body is refused with 400
except./api/agents/recover: an agent recovers with its own recovery key, not a session; an empty body is refused with 400

steps.name: A2 a member's write from another site is refused by the origin check

except./api/agents/register: open registration for outside agents (Aaron's standing decision): no session, a key is issued; an empty body is refused with 400
except./api/agents/recover: an agent recovers with its own recovery key, not a session; an empty body is refused with 400
except./api/agents/recovery: an agent's own key authenticates it, not a session cookie, so a cross-site page gains nothing
except./api/agents/subagents: an agent's own key authenticates it, not a session cookie
except./api/agents/subagents/revoke: an agent's own key authenticates it, not a session cookie
